intro.title: Adult autism screening
intro.copy: Answer 100 questions about social communication, sensory experiences, routines, development and everyday impact. Aspect groups your responses by area; it cannot diagnose autism or calculate a probability.
home.cardCopy: Questions cover autistic traits across several areas. Other possible explanations are considered separately.
home.modelNote: The scoring model is provisional and has not been clinically validated.
home.privacyCopy: Your answers stay in this browser on this device. Aspect has no account, analytics, or answer uploads.
consent.title: A few things to know.
consent.intro: Aspect is a screening tool for autistic traits in adults. It may identify patterns worth discussing with a professional, but it cannot diagnose autism.
consent.point1: This version is intended for adults aged 18 and over who can read English or German independently.
consent.point2: Think about your typical experience over the last 12 months, not your best or worst day, and not what seems “most autistic.”
consent.point3: For childhood questions, choose “I don’t remember” whenever you are unsure. You do not need to guess.
consent.point4: Your answers are saved only in this browser on this device. You may leave items unanswered.

results.scoreNote: Scores describe your responses in this assessment. They are not probabilities.
results.cannotTell: What this test cannot tell you
results.cannotTellCopy: A website cannot establish a diagnosis, reconstruct your full developmental history, or account for everything shaping your experience.
results.modelNote: The scoring model is provisional and has not been independently clinically validated. Scores are not probabilities.
results.summary.lower: Your answers show fewer of the patterns this provisional screening model looks for. Screening can miss people, and this result does not rule out autism.
results.summary.mixed: Your answers show some autism-associated patterns, but the overall profile is mixed. Developmental information, masking, overlapping traits or current circumstances may affect the picture.
results.summary.elevated: Your answers show a pattern across social communication and repetitive, predictable or sensory experiences. This screening signal may be worth exploring with a qualified professional.
results.standsOutBase: Review the domain profile below for the areas with the strongest responses.
results.complicatesBase: Self-report has limits. Childhood information, overlapping experiences and current mood or health can shape these answers.
results.nextElevated: If these patterns meaningfully affect your life, discussing them with a clinician experienced in adult autism assessment may be worthwhile.
results.nextMixed: You could bring this profile to a clinician experienced in adult autism assessment and discuss what fits, what does not, and what more information would help.
results.nextLower: A lower screening signal does not rule out autism. If you have ongoing questions, a conversation with a qualified professional is still an option.
results.masking: Your answers suggest substantial conscious social compensation. This can make outward social behaviour look easier than it feels internally.
results.devUncertain: Developmental history uncertain. Limited childhood information is not evidence against autism.
results.tooltip: This score describes your responses within this assessment. It is not a probability of autism.
results.otherHigh: Your answers also contain a strong attention and impulsivity pattern. ADHD and autism can occur together.
results.anxietyHigh: Fear of negative evaluation may contribute to some of the social difficulties you reported.
results.ocdHigh: Some repetitive behaviour appears linked to intrusive fears or feared consequences.
results.depressionHigh: Some current difficulties may vary with mood or periods of burnout or depression.
results.noContext: No strong parallel context signal appeared in these answers. This does not rule out other explanations.
results.quality.highCopy: Most items were answered, and the response checks showed few inconsistencies.
results.quality.moderateCopy: Some items were left blank or response checks were inconsistent. Interpret this profile with care.
results.quality.limitedCopy: Many items were unanswered or response checks raised substantial uncertainty. Treat this profile with additional caution.
results.childhood.strongCopy: Several childhood responses were available and support a more informative developmental picture.
results.childhood.partialCopy: Some childhood information was available, though parts of the picture remain uncertain.
results.childhood.limitedCopy: Few childhood responses were available. The developmental picture is uncertain.
results.domainTooltip: Score out of 100. Not a clinical measure.

method.title: What Aspect can and cannot do

method.sections.title: What Aspect can do
items: Ask about social communication, routines, sensory experiences, childhood, social adaptation, and everyday impact.
Summarize your answers by area and show a lower, mixed, or elevated screening signal.
Show ADHD-, anxiety-, OCD-, and mood-related responses separately as context. They do not reduce the autism-related signal.

method.sections.title: What Aspect cannot do
items: Diagnose autism or tell you the probability that you are autistic.
Observe how you communicate or verify what happened in your childhood.
Replace a professional assessment or decide what support you need.

method.sections.title: How to read the screening signal
method.sections.copy: “Elevated” means your answers match more of the patterns in this model; “mixed” means the pattern is less consistent; “lower” means fewer patterns matched. A lower signal does not rule out autism, and an elevated signal does not confirm it.

method.sections.title: How reliable is this version?
method.sections.copy: The scoring model is provisional and has not been clinically validated. Its accuracy has not been established. Scores reflect your responses, not a probability.

method.sections.title: What you can do next
method.sections.copy: If you want a fuller answer, consider bringing your result or questions to a qualified professional who assesses adults for autism. They can discuss your history and wider circumstances with you.

method.sections.title: Where your answers are kept
method.sections.copy: Your answers and results are saved in this browser on this device. Aspect does not use accounts, analytics, advertising trackers, or upload your assessment answers. Deleting local data also deletes saved results and your language choice.
